idea: Career transition coaching for architects leaving the profession
buyer: Disillusioned architects wanting to move into finance, tech or product
pain: They feel trapped and cannot translate their skills
v1: A transition programme with positioning and introductions
verdict: She has literally made this journey, which is powerful - but the buyers are architects, who cannot pay.

why.distribution: Extremely warm - her own peer group, many of whom are actively considering leaving.
why.demand: Real emotional urgency, though architects leaving the profession are by definition short of money.
why.fmf: She made exactly this transition successfully. Nobody is better placed.
why.defensibility: Her story is genuinely unique and referral-generating.
why.tailwind: Architectural dissatisfaction is a persistent and well-documented phenomenon.
why.ceiling: £1,800 x 40 people = £72k, and forty transition programmes is a full calendar.

ceiling_arithmetic: £1,800 x 40 people = £72k at a punishing delivery load. The buyers are underpaid architects, which caps the price. Structurally below target.
carries: The most emotionally compelling story-market fit in the entire set, with a very warm channel.
kills: Ceiling. Her ideal customer is defined partly by not having money.
test: Post her own transition story and count how many architects ask for a call.
test_fail: Many ask for free advice, none pay.
